sources.68ab5622e4e279831c33454d successMessaget: My hounds picked up the flash drives from the meeting room, you did a good job out there champion. I made sure they had left your payment there aswell, until next time.
sources.68ac5a291ad19f8bca0e4b57 successMessaget: "That's it"? Yeah, that's it, champion. I have everything I need now, you did a real good job out there. These Terragroup shipments are nothing that you should worry about, trust me, the information is in safe hands now.
sources.6812590e15f6bcbc89c75b34 successMessaget: Hey you managed to find them? Perfect, great job my guy! One of my associates will reach out to you with more details, until then you better stay safe out there!
sources.6812941396bf52b87fada560 successMessaget: Not even dust remained? Wow, these guys are greedy assholes. I'll stay in touch, you'll hear from me or Arshavir later.
sources.681295120afc09bdf4472485 successMessaget: Did you find the laptop? Great. I'll let someone check on it as soon as possible, thanks soldier. The radio repeaters are up and running too.
sources.6812967df2e90afe81ef3b59 successMessaget: Im looking at our database right now, looks like you completed the job, great! And now we wait, you enjoy your free time now.
sources.68129c189210aba950e5d57b successMessaget: Well done bro! Let's see when they notice the weapon case wasn't filled with real guns but the replicas.
sources.68129ced44202136962c541c failMessageText: So you were warned, and you still didn't listen? You can't run away from the consequences, and you won't be able to run away from them, I suggest you will be extra careful out there, don't ask for help any time soon merc.
sources.68129d0adb209aeef7100be1 successMessaget: Marvelous, a good day indeed. Thank you for your honesty.
sources.68129d0adb209aeef7100be1 failMessageText: I would lie if I wouldn't have expected this from someone like you! Why the greed, hmm? Did someone promise you some luxury vacation in exchange for the weapons or what? Unbelievable... Get out of here, I don't want to look at you right now.
sources.68129eb2b43bb4d35d9f5c9a successMessaget: Did you get visitors yet? Fantastic work out there my friend, now we listen for the bang, it's never a bad day when you get rid of these dogs.
sources.68135e68f72643bf2a708c5d successMessaget: So, did you think about your action? I hope so! I won't be fooled by you again, that's for sure.
sources.6813d49816860442e2a11c2f successMessaget: Have you taken care of it? Alright then, I'll send you a cut of what you deserve.
sources.6813d64b31f920cdbc15ab23 successMessaget: Did you find them? Good. You'll hear from me later.
sources.6813db938449d87cea2cf14a successMessaget: So, they work? Very well then, give me some time to think about what else we can do, until then...
sources.68b06a005f3eaaf2a27bb49a successMessaget: The smell of fresh clean green bills, fantastic. Alright then, shall we move on?
sources.68b075f82fe99bf60e9ad7f2 successMessaget: So you found it huh, anyone there cause you trouble? I hope not, come on... I know you would have dealt with it like a professional! Anyway, your payment is on it's way.
sources.68b07a0c7bb2dcdc1c0d572e successMessaget: You found them all huh? Impressive, impressive indeed, so... Well done champion.
sources.68b07b66e0d3845de90e086a successMessaget: Finished the job? Well done, I guess we can move on then.
sources.68b07cd25a4cafa65a846d57 successMessaget: You found them all? Great, leave the rest of the work to me, I'll make sure you will receive your payment in time.
sources.68b08361d560747536f0930f successMessaget: What I heard about your gunsmithing skills is true, very impressive. I assume Arsenyevich teached you this art? Hmm, very interesting.
sources.68b08a981f4236176e8f0fed successMessaget: So how's the gear? Pretty cool, right? I'm sure this will be excellent news for Victor, well done.
sources.68b0a88fb31efae4dc7ee064 successMessaget: Yeah that's everything, it's on the way to him now. Your money should arrive at your hideout any moment now.
sources.68c0bfe82d85ac7091436bb2 successMessaget: Hey! You earned their trust? Hell yeah! You know how much of a help this will be? I'll contact you soon.
sources.68c0c208f0fcd1b184750ffd successMessaget: You're back, just in time. I saw you placed down the transmitter, yeah? Great! You know how it works, and don't forget to pick up your payment.
sources.68c1eff9c5b5f2e47b774a57 successMessaget: Yeah those should do fine, thanks champion.
sources.68c312d1609a82be2a2d52db successMessaget: Did you find the places that match the description? Perfect, I suppose this will be a huge help to this operation, thanks champion.
sources.68c31bd427110f29df6be2ab successMessaget: Did you find the places that match the description? Perfect, I suppose this will be a huge help to this operation, thanks champion.
sources.68c31f71aa355c62f3b4f6e3 successMessaget: Hey you cracked open these things? Let me take a look at them, I'll give you a call soon when I figured out what to do myself, hey don't give me that look I don't know everything either! Until then...
sources.68c322a2a56a64e8084d538f successMessaget: Everything stashed? Good. Now I just need to make sure none of these dealers stick their nose everywhere.
sources.68c42206071c2a5f10ea8202 successMessaget: Ref's contraband? Where did you manage to obtain these goods from? Actually, forget it, we will take this matter into our own hand, your reward is stashed at the usual location, be there before bandits find it.
sources.68c42206071c2a5f10ea8202 failMessageText: You know nothing? Alright, I believe you, our reward would have been too tempting for you to lie to us, some of your colleagues might help us then.
sources.68c422290241ea1aa4fb9587 successMessaget: Hey! You found that "cargo", cool! I know I could rely on you, friend.
sources.68c422290241ea1aa4fb9587 failMessageText: No? Alright then. I assume you actually know nothing because someone like you never says no to earning a ton of money.
sources.68c422298f2722ca9f7d24a3 successMessaget: Oh wow, I expected a lot but this? So Ref is also one of these "smugglers", interesting.
sources.68c422298f2722ca9f7d24a3 failMessageText: Alright, you know nothing, thanks for trying to help though.
sources.68c42fd92a030b87c52e2f65 successMessaget: All set? Good, I'll make sure this guy takes the bait.
sources.68c432f157baa1fbcd13447d successMessaget: You found the dead drop? Holy shit, that's amazing, I'll send over some guys ASAP, thanks man!
sources.68c438d9fdcd3c3aa8c96f62 successMessaget: Have you brought everything? Perfect, I guess this won't be any of your concern now, until I require your help of course, take care and enjoy your payment.
sources.680e0c71597b0c96599d5587 successMessaget: All clear? Shit, so he is actually gone. I have an idea where he could have went, give me some time to prepare something.
sources.680e12e530d8f164e7fcd99b successMessaget: All his weapons are gone? That's not good, not at all... Someone knows too much. You think one of the other dealers is involved in this?
sources.680e12e530d8f164e7fcd99b failMessageText: What the fuck? We've been through this - Leave these guys alone, you stay down while I talk to them to calm them down.
sources.680e19fee0ca81b62f5a448a successMessaget: Did you find something? Damn it! Still no trace of Ryba, time is ticking my friend, we need to find out what happened.
sources.680e1fe9bb891db767cc10a2 successMessaget: Alright then, I'll bring the bottles to my place, you know where to find me, come back later for a drink or two, then we can figure out what to do next, got it?
sources.680e1fe9bb891db767cc10a2 acceptPlayerMes: That will do, thanks, I will bring what I can find.
sources.680e1fe9bb891db767cc10a2 declinePlayerMe: Give me some time to think about it.

sources.680e6fa7f03da221e8c72a7f successMessaget: All of them are still locked? Okay this gives me an idea, let me go through our archives, expect to hear from me soon.
sources.680e21a059d722e8adfef054 successMessaget: Nice work man! Let's hope nobody finds all this shit now.
sources.680e21a059d722e8adfef054 acceptPlayerMes: So this Ryba guy is dead or what? Okay I got it, none of my concern, I can help with hiding his stuff.
sources.680e21a059d722e8adfef054 completePlayerM: I stashed all of Ryba's Gear, let's hope Ref's people don't find any of it.
sources.680e3923013c853dc48a35bb successMessaget: Fantastic, this is it! That's the diary with all the information on Ryba, let me take a copy of everything, I'll contact you whenever we can make our next move.
sources.680e778d7b773d357db874c5 successMessaget: The room is empty? Fuck... Someone knew about this, we might have a rat here, you'll hear from me soon.
sources.680e807527f51292fa6b2f9e successMessaget: Thank you for doing the right thing warrior! Well done. I knew I could trust you.

sources.680e8127463f0c3d59af8056 failMessageText: I should have known it was you, oh you're a sneaky one. Don't expect that to be a compliment you traitor! sources.680e808b6d94abeb5a2dbc70 successMessaget: Good thing you chose the right thing to do, I'm proud of you. I have some things here that you might need.
sources.680e808b6d94abeb5a2dbc70 acceptPlayerMes: Let me grab the diary then, expect me soon.
sources.680e808b6d94abeb5a2dbc70 completePlayerM: I hope we can settle this, this cat and mouse game was exhausting.

sources.68b85170b361cb40dcf8035e successMessaget: Found everything we need? Great, we're trying to connect to the transmitter you placed down, maybe we can get some info out of these things.

sources.68c044ff8b79163e3eab83a1 successMessaget: So you found his car? It was crashed? Hmm, well I guess he didn't make it out alive then, oh and thanks for bringing the military documents, they're in safe hands now, well done.
